text.zh-CN:
哮喘是气道容易发炎、变窄的慢性疾病，症状可以反复变化。

- 喘息是呼吸时像哨子的声音，也可咳嗽、气短或胸紧。
- 夜间、清晨或运动后加重很常见，控制良好时多数人能正常活动。
text.en:
Asthma is chronic airway inflammation and narrowing with variable symptoms.

- Wheeze is a whistling breathing sound; cough, breathlessness or tightness may occur.
- Night, morning or exercise symptoms are common; good control usually supports normal activity.

text.zh-CN:
先天倾向与环境共同参与。

- 过敏和家族哮喘史会增加可能性。
- 病毒、烟雾、空气污染、冷空气和某些过敏原可诱发发作。
- 诱因与病因不同，运动诱发症状不意味着应终身避免运动。
text.en:
Inherited susceptibility and environment interact.

- Allergy and family asthma history increase likelihood.
- Viruses, smoke, pollution, cold air and allergens may trigger attacks.
- A trigger is not the whole cause; exercise symptoms do not mean avoiding activity forever.

text.zh-CN:
严重发作可能危及生命。

- 喘得说不出完整句子、发青、嗜睡或迅速恶化，应呼叫急救。
- 按自己的书面行动计划使用缓解吸入器；达到计划上限仍无改善或没有药时求救。
- 坐直，不自行开车，不靠喝水或蒸汽处理重症。
text.en:
Severe attacks can threaten life.

- Unable to speak full sentences, blue colour, drowsiness or rapid deterioration requires emergency help.
- Use your reliever according to the written plan; seek emergency care if the plan’s limit does not help or no inhaler is available.
- Sit upright and do not drive or rely on drinks or steam.

text.zh-CN:
控制不足应主动复诊。

- 夜间醒来、活动受限或缓解药使用增加，联系医生调整。
- 首次反复喘咳需要评估，不借他人药物长期用。
- NHS建议发作恢复后2天内复查，讨论下一次预防。
text.en:
Poor control needs review.

- Night waking, limited activity or increasing reliever use should trigger reassessment.
- New recurring wheeze or cough needs diagnosis rather than borrowed treatment.
- NHS advises review within two days after recovery from an attack.

text.zh-CN:
诊断要证明气道变化，并排除其他原因。

- 医生询问时间规律、诱因和家族过敏史。
- 肺功能测量吹气情况，峰流速记录可观察日间变化；必要时查炎症指标。
- 症状间歇期检查可能正常，需结合重复测量，而不是一次正常就排除。
text.en:
Diagnosis examines variable airflow and other causes.

- Clinicians ask about patterns, triggers and allergy history.
- Breathing tests and peak-flow diaries measure airflow; selected tests assess inflammation.
- Testing between episodes may be normal, so repeated measurements may matter.

text.zh-CN:
咳嗽和气短并不都等于哮喘。

- 感染、慢阻肺和鼻后滴流可引起类似表现。
- 反流或声带功能问题也可造成咳嗽、呼吸不适。
- 突发气促、胸痛或吸入异物需要另外急评，不能不断追加哮喘药。
text.en:
Cough and breathlessness are not always asthma.

- Infection, COPD and postnasal drip can resemble it.
- Reflux and vocal-cord problems also cause symptoms.
- Abrupt breathlessness, chest pain or choking needs separate urgent assessment rather than repeated asthma medicine.

text.zh-CN:
长期治疗同时控制炎症和急性症状。

- 含吸入激素的方案降低气道炎症和发作风险。
- 根据具体处方，缓解药与维持药可以分开，也可使用同一种合适的组合吸入器。
- 重症可能需要专科注射治疗；先核对吸入技术和规律使用。
text.en:
Long-term care controls inflammation and acute symptoms.

- Inhaled-steroid-containing treatment reduces inflammation and attacks.
- Maintenance and relief may use separate medicines or an appropriate prescribed combination inhaler.
- Severe disease may need specialist injections; check technique and adherence first.

text.zh-CN:
认清每个吸入器的作用。

- 支气管扩张药放松气道，可有手抖、心悸；不能只靠频繁缓解药代替抗炎治疗。
- 吸入激素可引起口腔霉菌或声嘶，按指导漱口和使用装置。
- 口服激素及孟鲁司特等有各自风险，出现情绪或睡眠明显变化应及时联系医生。
text.en:
Know each inhaler’s role.

- Bronchodilators open airways and may cause tremor or palpitations; repeated relief alone does not replace anti-inflammatory care.
- Inhaled steroids may cause oral thrush or hoarseness; follow rinsing and device advice.
- Oral steroids and montelukast have specific risks; report major mood or sleep changes.

text.zh-CN:
饮食支持整体健康。

- 保持均衡饮食和合适体重。
- 只有明确食物过敏才按相关方案避开，不需要所有人禁奶或海鲜。
- 保健品和特殊食谱没有可靠证据取代哮喘控制药。
text.en:
Diet supports overall health.

- Maintain balanced nutrition and a suitable weight.
- Avoid foods under a confirmed allergy plan, not universal milk or seafood bans.
- Supplements and special diets do not replace asthma control medicines.

text.zh-CN:
日常管理需要一个能执行的计划。

- 随身带所需吸入器，定期让专业人员查看技术。
- 按计划记录夜间症状、活动受限和峰流速等。
- 避免烟雾，规律活动；出现计划中的恶化信号就行动。
text.en:
Use an actionable daily plan.

- Carry needed inhalers and have technique checked.
- Track night symptoms, activity limitation and peak flow when advised.
- Avoid smoke, remain active and act on the plan’s deterioration signals.

text.zh-CN:
年龄和妊娠影响设备与随访。

- 幼儿可能不能完成标准肺功能，需要随症状发展复评。
- 儿童装置和辅助储雾罐按年龄能力选择。
- 孕期保持控制对母婴重要，不应因担忧自行停用治疗。
text.en:
Age and pregnancy affect devices and monitoring.

- Young children may not complete standard breathing tests and need reassessment over time.
- Choose devices and spacers for the child’s ability.
- Good control protects parent and baby during pregnancy; do not independently stop treatment.

text.zh-CN:
哮喘常需长期管理，但多数可控制良好。

- 至少按当地建议定期复查，NHS建议每年至少一次。
- 评估发作次数、吸入技术、副作用和行动计划。
- 长期无症状后是否减药也由医生判断，不能视为已经永久治愈。
text.en:
Asthma often needs long-term care but is usually manageable.

- Follow local review schedules; NHS recommends at least yearly review.
- Check attacks, technique, adverse effects and the action plan.
- Even after prolonged control, clinician-guided reduction is different from permanent cure.

text.zh-CN:
控制差主要增加发作与生活受限。

- 频繁夜间症状影响睡眠、学习和工作。
- 严重发作可造成缺氧，需住院甚至呼吸支持。
- 减少发作也能减少反复口服激素带来的负担。
text.en:
Poor control increases attacks and functional limitations.

- Night symptoms disrupt sleep, school and work.
- Severe attacks can impair oxygen supply and require hospital respiratory support.
- Preventing attacks also reduces repeated oral-steroid exposure.

text.zh-CN:
预防重点是减少加重。

- 按处方抗炎治疗，保持吸入技术正确。
- 戒烟并减少确认的诱因，按当地建议接种呼吸道相关疫苗。
- 检查新药是否会诱发哮喘，运动诱发症状应调整方案而非放弃活动。
text.en:
Prevention focuses on exacerbations.

- Use prescribed anti-inflammatory treatment correctly.
- Avoid smoke and identified triggers and follow local respiratory vaccination advice.
- Check new medicines for asthma effects; adapt treatment for exercise symptoms rather than abandoning activity.
